title: Bind helper277 lifetime to exact residue arithmetic and charged decode
body:
PR4017 supplied a reversible rounded residual, but local invertibility did not establish the real helper lifetime's linear cleanup or its recursive allowance. This contribution binds **helper277 in both current pinned PR3945 providers** to49 scalar touches, **five rank-one physical climbs**, and49 inverse-cleanup touches on private buffer981. It also explicitly corrects PR4017's rank-five-cost shorthand: rank5 is the completed residual/owner width, not one paid chronological call. The old macro theorems/counts remain intact.

The constructive addition is exact dyadic arithmetic over `(Z/(2^b−1)Z)[i]`, a literal X/CNOT/Toffoli implementation with no additional workspace, and an explicit endpoint numerical decoder. Ring linearity preserves the complete source dirty-helper identities; no rounding record is needed. All unused bit codes have a total reversible extension, while ring/numerical semantics require canonical residues. For input component integer boundA, `M>2048A` recovers exact output on gridDelta/32. The optional decoder is fully charged. This finer-grid contract needs a real consumer before adoption.

At b32, the five actual physical climbs plus98 touching scalar instructions cost29,766,862,848 Toffoli before optional decode and all other provider work. This is a conservative constructive invoice, **not a speedup, recursive fit, selected stock coefficient, new kappa or supplier admission**. The source's five rank-one charges have no authenticated scalar-gate conversion here. Different numerical contracts/precision prevent treating8 modular additions versus18 earlier word primitives as an equal-work benchmark.

Validation: source-byte authentication; all2,560 phase-bearing physical-climb columns and512 terminal-residual columns; all1,360 small generalized-adder states and336 literal elementary-adder states;4,352 complete pair states including unused codes and398 elementary pair cases; actual source primal/dual/boundary/private-buffer identities; exact numerical endpoint recovery; phase, late-add, cleanup, missing modular-wrap, even-modulus and fixed-grid rejection controls. Normal and optimized registered replay, Git-free replay, exact committed-byte/source-history gate and official export receipts are reported in the publication handoff. Hosted CI is pending at submission.

Package: `research/staged544-exact-residue-lifetime/`. Scope, full ledger, reproducible commands, exact sources, explicit PR4017 correction and open next questions are included. The separate all-cut height bound assumes common-grid **logical** inputs and is not the b32 endpoint benchmark; physical nonempty entrance adapters need their own conversion.
